data.reasoning: The package is a standard Python AUR package downloading a pinned source tarball from the official GitHub repository with a valid SHA-256 checksum. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) during the full review of the PKGBUILD, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete the full review of PKGBUILD due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: If a model fails with an API error during the full file review but its initial audit (or another model's review) successfully covered the file and found it safe, the tool should aggregate the successful coverage rather than failing the entire package audit as inconclusive.
